crossRefs.note: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

translations.web: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
translations.bsb: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen.
translations.kjv: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
translations.asv: By the breath of God ice is given; And the breadth of the waters is straitened.
